BiblicalUsage: Moadjah is a priest, the head of a father's house in the days of Joiakim, named in the list of those who serve when the wall is dedicated. His house stands in its course among the priests who return.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the priests in the lists are the quiet backbone of the return: named, counted, and standing in their course.
